title: Usage-Aware Progressive Image Retention
problem: Cloud storage keeps every image at full quality whether anyone looks at it or not. The study asks when it is worth stepping rarely used images down, and how to compare retention policies fairly when they spend different amounts.
method: A deterministic simulation that compares storage retention policies, with a rule for when two policies can be compared fixed before any results were seen.
notShown: Results, charts, the full protocol and the data are held until the study is published, so the paper is the first place they appear.
